symbols.name: codeExtension
symbols.summary: Adds code blocks with syntax highlighting to a schema.

children.value:
Adds code blocks with syntax highlighting to a schema. Without it, code
blocks still load and save, but they show as a placeholder.

symbols.name: codeLanguageLabel
symbols.summary: Resolve a stored language string to its display label.

children.value:
Resolve a stored language string to its display label. Matches by id first,
then by alias (so an imported "js" fence shows "JavaScript"); an unknown
non-empty tag is shown verbatim, and an empty tag falls back to "Plain Text".

symbols.name: highlightLine
sigs: function highlightLine(line: string, language: string): CodeToken[]
symbols.summary: Splits one line of code into colored pieces for `language`.

children.value: Splits one line of code into colored pieces for
language

. An empty line
gives an empty list. An empty or unknown language gives one plain piece.
Joining the pieces' text always gives back
line

exactly. Each line is
colored on its own, so a comment or string that spans several lines is
colored only on its first line.

symbols.name: CodeNode
symbols.summary: The code block node: draws a multi-line, monospace code block with syntax highlighting and handles typing inside it.

children.value:
The code block node: draws a multi-line, monospace code block with syntax
highlighting and handles typing inside it.
codeExtension

installs it
for you; subclass it to change how the block looks or behaves.

symbols.name: INDENT_CODE
symbols.summary: Adds two spaces to the start of every line the caret or selection touches in a code block.

children.value:
Adds two spaces to the start of every line the caret or selection touches in
a code block. It does nothing outside a code block. Use it for a toolbar
button, since a phone keyboard has no Tab key.

symbols.name: OUTDENT_CODE
symbols.summary: Removes up to two leading spaces from every line the caret or selection touches in a code block.

children.value:
Removes up to two leading spaces from every line the caret or selection
touches in a code block. It does nothing outside a code block, or when none
of those lines start with a space.
